name: build-script-reads-requires-and-values-once
description: A build script is read under the one static-module rule: a require that createRequire returns is the platform's and binds the bundler, an options object in a top-level let binding is read through to its initializer, a call through the script's own require function binds the bundler too, since a script read without a type checker proves no require its own, and a call through a parameter that shadows the bundler's binding is no build call.
